description:
Escape or unescape a string for JSON, HTML, XML, JavaScript, or SQL.

Returns: Escaped or unescaped string for the chosen format.
Example input: {"text":"He said \"hi\"","format":"json","mode":"escape"}
On error, includes hint: `mode` is 'escape' or 'unescape'; `format` is one of: json, html, xml, js, sql.
name: escape_characters
title: Escape / unescape characters
